Closing this PR, since this approach was already evaluated and ruled out. Reverting the selection after it has changed means that selection and value change listeners receive the refused selection, which is not how field bindings behave: a field never fires an event for a value that the write callback refused. Listeners registered after bindValue also receive the events in the wrong order, so they end up with the refused value. For the alternative approaches that were tried and why they also didn't work out well, see https://github.com/vaadin/flow-components/pull/10696#issuecomment-7162353209
